#  12717 - Business English for ERM Students (C1) Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12717**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Business English for ERM Students (C1)**  |  
|  Wirtschaftsenglisch für ERM Studenten (C1)   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Riebow, Ute 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will acquire and consolidate fundamental skills which they will need in their professional life. Major emphasis will be placed on skills which the participants need to master typical situations in oral and written form appropriately.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Understanding texts
  * Acquisition of typical technical terms
  * Improving writing skills (note taking, descriptions, job applications, formal correspondence, writing reports, chart description, structure and style of scientific texts)
  * Improving oral skills (participating in discussions, meeting people, interpersonal skills, giving presentations, telephoning, presenting products, negotiating)
  * Preparation of typical documents and application of typical strategies in a simulation game (founding one's own company)

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Course participants should have very good knowledge of English on level B2 or C1.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Script and additional materials on Moodle platform  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * a test (60 minutes), 25% of final grade
  * a 15-minute presentation, 25% of final grade
  * a written report (2 pages), 25% of final grade
  * a complete folder with several documents, 25% of final grade

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Betriebswirtschaftslehre / keine PO 

 |  
| Remarks:  |  
| Module Components:  | Business English for ERM Students (C1)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
